summary: Iteration 15: Tested Quiz-shuffle (session-based) and Kas-chart features. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering shuffle persistence per student, re-start same order, scoring with reverse mapping (confirmed 100% when choosing correct option text), session reset on question edit, time_limit metadata, role gate (siswa-only), and kas chart (siswa/guru/ketua/admin access, months clamping 3<=N<=12, bucket shape, chart reflects new tx). Frontend UI validated: kas-chart-card visible for siswa (viewer), kas-chart-months selector functional (3/6/12), kas-chart-empty shown when no tx, bar chart renders after ketua adds a tx (refreshKey triggers reload). No quizzes available in demo DB so quiz modal UI was not visually exercised, but backend start/attempt API fully verified end-to-end via a created+deleted TEST quiz.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1)/height(-1)' once because container is hidden during initial render; harmless but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1190 shuffled_questions uses len(out) for opt_orders index — correct but fragile; using enumerate(sess['q_order']) would be clearer.

server.py:1319 non-session (legacy) scoring path still exists for quizzes created before shuffling; good backward-compat but ensure new quizzes always have a session (currently guaranteed because /start creates one).
QuizIn.questions is List[dict] without inner validation — a mistyped 'answer' (string vs int) silently scores 0. Consider a nested Pydantic model to validate option index.
